messages.text: It's a shame that when creating a token, you can't add the logo, social media links, website, etc. Nor can you view them on the explorer
It would be interesting if token creators on the Ergo blockchain could directly add a logo and links to social networks on the owner’s dashboard
Like on ETH and Solana, although on Solana, it’s even easier to create a wallet and token with just a few command lines, including the logo
